skills.name: LCD Conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator for two fractions with unlike denominators and rewrite both as equivalent fractions over that denominator.

skills.name: Numerator Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerator of the subtrahend from the numerator of the minuend once both fractions share a common denominator.

skills.name: Whole/Fraction Decomposition
skills.definition: Separate a mixed number (or a whole number treated as having a 0 fractional part) into its whole-number and fractional components so each can be subtracted independently.

skills.name: Borrow Regrouping
skills.definition: When subtracting the fractional parts yields a negative value, convert one unit from the whole part into d/d and add it to the minuend's fraction numerator, then subtract again.

skills.name: Result Simplification
skills.definition: Reduce the final fractional result to lowest terms, or recognize that it collapses to 0 or a whole number.

skills.name: Improper Mixed-Number Regrouping
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into standard form by moving the excess into the whole-number part before subtracting.

skills.name: Same-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract numerators of two fractions that already share (or have been converted to) a common denominator.

skills.name: LCD conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator for unlike-denominator fractions and convert both to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a resulting fraction to its lowest terms.

skills.name: Normalize improper mixed number
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is ≥ the denominator into standard mixed-number form before subtracting.

skills.name: Whole-part subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number parts of two mixed numbers (or a mixed number and a whole number) independently of the fraction parts.

skills.name: Borrow/regroup
skills.definition: When the fraction subtraction would be negative (including treating a whole-number minuend as whole+0/d), borrow 1 from the whole part (as d/d) and recompute the fraction difference.

skills.name: Subtract Numerators (Common Denominator)
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that already share the same denominator to obtain the fractional difference.

skills.name: Find Common Denominator
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator for two fractions with different denominators and convert each to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Simplify Fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Decompose Whole and Fractional Parts
skills.definition: Split a mixed number (or treat a whole number as N + 0/d) into separate whole-number and fractional components and subtract the whole-number parts independently.

skills.name: Borrow from Whole Number
skills.definition: When subtracting the fractional parts yields a negative value, convert one unit from the whole-number part into an equivalent d/d fraction and add it to the fraction part before subtracting.

skills.name: Regroup Improper Fractional Part
skills.definition: Recognize a mixed number whose fractional part has numerator greater than or equal to its denominator and convert it into standard mixed-number form before carrying out the subtraction.

skills.name: Common Denominator Conversion
skills.definition: Find the LCD for fractions with unlike denominators and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Numerator Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that share a common denominator to obtain the difference.

skills.name: Fraction Simplification
skills.definition: Reduce a resulting fraction to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Mixed-Number Decomposition
skills.definition: Separate a mixed number, or a whole number reframed as 'whole + 0/d', into whole and fractional parts so each can be subtracted independently.

skills.name: Borrowing/Regrouping
skills.definition: When subtracting fractional parts yields a negative value, borrow one whole unit (rewritten as d/d) from the whole-number part and re-subtract.

skills.name: Direct aligned subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract two numerators that already share a common denominator, and/or subtract two whole-number parts of mixed numbers, once operands are expressed with matching denominators.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator of two unlike denominators and rewrite both fractions as equivalent fractions over that denominator.

skills.name: Borrowing/regrouping
skills.definition: When the fraction-part subtraction is negative, decrease the whole part by 1 and add a full unit (d/d) to the minuend's fraction part, then re-subtract.

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction by dividing out a common factor, or recognize a zero numerator as no remaining fractional part, to express the answer in lowest terms or integer form.

skills.name: Whole-to-mixed conversion
skills.definition: Rewrite a standalone whole number as an equivalent mixed number with a zero-valued fraction part over the needed denominator so it can be aligned with a mixed number for subtraction.

skills.name: Improper fraction-part normalization
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is itself improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into standard mixed-number form by regrouping the excess into the whole part, before subtracting.
